title: DOJ moves to recover USDC tied to Binance hack

scenes.narration: The Block reports the Justice Department is seeking to recover about {$1.17 billion|one point one seven billion dollars} in USDC tied to the Binance hack [src:theblock].

onScreen.title: DOJ seeks USDC tied to hack

scenes.narration: DefiLlama lists Binance's October 29 loss at {$6,360,000,000|six point three six billion dollars} [src:defillama-hacks]. Chainalysis puts it at {$6.4 billion|six point four billion dollars} [src:chainalysis-blog].
Rekt's post-mortem says a fake job interview led to Binance's signing service, and the funds left across 11 chains [src:rekt-news].

Our check, in DefiLlama's public tracker: 52 incidents in the 30 days to November 24. 14 share Binance's classification there, frontend and infrastructure. The 30 days before had 2. A busy month for infrastructure.

analysis.detail: DefiLlama lists 52 incidents in the 30 days from Oct 26 to Nov 24. As listed by DefiLlama, Binance's $6,360,000,000 loss is the largest of the 39 with a stated loss. 14 of the 52 share its DefiLlama classification (frontend and infrastructure), up from 2 in the 30 days before that. 7 of the 52 share its DefiLlama technique (key leaked via infrastructure).
analysis.method: Read the DefiLlama /hacks rows the radar cached at 2026-11-24T16:32:49Z (source "defillama-30d" in brief.json, facts t1..t54). Kept the 52 rows dated 2026-10-26 to 2026-11-24. Ranked the 39 rows with a stated loss by DefiLlama's own figure (one source, no averaging); this incident is number 1. Counted rows whose classification is "Frontend & Infrastructure": 14. Counted rows dated 2026-09-26 to 2026-10-25 (the 30 days before) with the same classification: 2. Counted rows whose technique is "Key Leaked via Infrastructure": 7.
